mapper.select: SELECT artist_id, artist_name, artist_image_url, created_at FROM artists ORDER BY artist_name
SELECT artist_id, artist_name, artist_image_url, created_at FROM artists WHERE artist_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY artist_name

SELECT s.song_id, s.song_title, s.artist_id, s.theme_id, s.album_image_url, s.release_date FROM songs s JOIN artists a ON s.artist_id = a.artist_id WHERE s.song_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.artist_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY s.release_date DESC
SELECT room_id, room_name, room_description, target_id, theme_id, room_image_url, created_at FROM chat_rooms WHERE room_type = 'artist' AND target_id = #{artistId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT room_id AS roomId, room_name AS roomName, room_description AS roomDescription, room_type AS roomType, target_id AS targetId, theme_id AS themeId, room_image_url AS roomImageUrl, created_at AS createdAt FROM chat_rooms WHERE room_type = 'song' AND target_id = #{songId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT room_id, room_name, room_description, room_type, theme_id, room_image_url, created_at FROM chat_rooms WHERE UPPER(room_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{keyword}), '%') OR UPPER(COALESCE(room_description, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{keyword}), '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT artist_id, artist_name, artist_image_url, created_at FROM artists WHERE artist_id = #{artistId}
SELECT song_id, song_title, artist_id, theme_id, album_image_url, release_date FROM songs WHERE song_id = #{songId}
SELECT song_id, song_title, artist_id, theme_id, album_image_url, release_date FROM songs WHERE theme_id = #{themeId}
SELECT theme_id, theme_name, created_at FROM themes ORDER BY theme_name

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT cm.message_id, cm.room_id, cm.member_id, m.nickname, cm.message, cm.sent_at FROM chat_messages cm JOIN member m ON cm.member_id = m.id WHERE cm.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY cm.message_id DESC LIMIT 50 ) sub ORDER BY message_id ASC

SELECT room_id AS roomId, room_name AS roomName, room_description AS roomDescription, room_type AS roomType, target_id AS targetId, theme_id AS themeId, room_image_url AS roomImageUrl, created_at AS createdAt FROM chat_rooms WHERE room_type = #{roomType} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT theme_id, theme_name, created_at FROM themes WHERE theme_id = #{themeId}
SELECT song_id, artist_id, theme_id, song_title, album_image_url, release_date FROM songs ORDER BY release_date DESC

SELECT cr.room_id AS roomId, cr.room_name AS roomName, cr.room_description AS roomDescription, cr.target_id AS targetId, cr.theme_id AS themeId, cr.room_image_url AS roomImageUrl, cr.created_at AS createdAt FROM chat_rooms cr JOIN chat_room_members crm ON cr.room_id = crm.room_id WHERE crm.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY cr.created_at DESC

SELECT cr.room_id AS roomId, cr.room_name AS roomName, cr.room_description AS roomDescription, cr.room_type AS roomType, cr.target_id AS targetId, cr.theme_id AS themeId, cr.room_image_url AS roomImageUrl, cr.created_at AS createdAt, cr.owner_id AS ownerId, m.nickname AS ownerName FROM chat_rooms cr LEFT JOIN member m ON cr.owner_id = m.id WHERE cr.room_id = #{roomId}

SELECT cr.room_id AS roomId, cr.room_name AS roomName, cr.room_description AS roomDescription, cr.room_image_url AS roomImageUrl, cr.created_at AS createdAt FROM chat_rooms cr JOIN chat_room_members crm ON cr.room_id = crm.room_id WHERE crm.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY cr.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT room_id AS roomId, room_name AS roomName, room_description AS roomDescription, room_type AS roomType, target_id AS targetId, theme_id AS themeId, room_image_url AS roomImageUrl, owner_id AS ownerId, created_at AS createdAt FROM chat_rooms WHERE room_type='artist' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_rooms WHERE room_type='artist'

SELECT room_id AS roomId, room_name AS roomName, room_description AS roomDescription, room_type AS roomType, target_id AS targetId, theme_id AS themeId, room_image_url AS roomImageUrl, owner_id AS ownerId, created_at AS createdAt FROM chat_rooms WHERE room_type='song' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_rooms WHERE room_type='song'

SELECT cm.message_id AS messageId, cm.room_id AS roomId, cm.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS nickname, cm.message AS message, cm.sent_at AS sentAt, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_room_members crm WHERE crm.room_id = cm.room_id AND crm.member_id != cm.member_id AND crm.last_read_message_id < cm.message_id ) AS unreadCount FROM chat_messages cm JOIN member m ON cm.member_id = m.id WHERE cm.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY cm.message_id ASC

SELECT cm.message_id AS messageId, cm.room_id AS roomId, cm.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS nickname, cm.message AS message, cm.sent_at AS sentAt, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_room_members crm WHERE crm.room_id = cm.room_id AND crm.member_id != cm.member_id AND crm.last_read_message_id < cm.message_id ) AS unreadCount FROM chat_messages cm JOIN member m ON cm.member_id = m.id WHERE cm.message_id = #{messageId}

SELECT cm.message_id AS messageId, cm.room_id AS roomId, cm.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS nickname, cm.message AS message, cm.sent_at AS sentAt, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_room_members crm WHERE crm.room_id = cm.room_id AND crm.member_id != cm.member_id AND crm.last_read_message_id < cm.message_id ) AS unreadCount FROM chat_messages cm JOIN member m ON cm.member_id = m.id WHERE cm.room_id = #{roomId} AND cm.message_id > #{lastMessageId} ORDER BY cm.message_id

SELECT crm.room_id, crm.member_id, m.nickname, crm.join_at FROM chat_room_members crm JOIN member m ON crm.member_id = m.id JOIN chat_rooms cr ON crm.room_id = cr.room_id WHERE crm.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN crm.member_id = cr.owner_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.nickname

SELECT id AS member_id, nickname, NULL AS room_id, NULL AS join_at FROM member WHERE id IN
#{memberId}
SELECT artist_id FROM artists WHERE artist_name = #{artistName} LIMIT 1
SELECT song_id FROM songs WHERE song_title = #{songTitle} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_rooms ( room_name, room_description, room_type, target_id, theme_id, room_image_url, owner_id ) VALUES ( #{roomName}, #{roomDescription}, #{roomType}, #{targetId}, #{themeId}, #{roomImageUrl}, #{ownerId} )
INSERT INTO chat_room_members ( room_id, member_id, last_read_message_id ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{memberId}, 0 )
INSERT INTO chat_messages ( room_id, member_id, message, sent_at ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{memberId}, #{message}, NOW() )
INSERT INTO reports ( room_id, reporter_id, reported_id, reason ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{reporterId}, #{reportedId}, #{reason} )
